title: RIFTT: Robust Identification of Fusion genes in Tumor Transcriptomes.
snippet: Fusion genes serve as crucial biomarkers for cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy, yet many detection tools lead to high false-positive rates and poor consensus. title: Psychobiotics: A Paradigm Shift in Dermatological Disorders.
snippet: Recent clinical studies have demonstrated an intricate bidirectional system in the gut-brain-skin axis. title: Genetic Polymorphisms and Hemostatic-Inflammatory Biomarkers in Schizophrenia Patients Receiving Antipsychotic Treatment.
snippet: Patients with schizophrenia who receive antipsychotics carry an elevated risk of thromboembolic disease, but hemostatic and inflammatory markers vary widely between patients given the same drug.
